claim: Package identity declared as com.life360.android.safetymapd with SDK 26-33 and core location/telemetry permissions.
observed_fact: AndroidManifest.xml declares package='com.life360.android.safetymapd', compileSdkVersion='33', and requests ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, and ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.

claim: Process isolation separating UI main process from dedicated :service background process hosting EventController (foregroundServiceType="location"), shielding location tracking from UI-level crashes, subject to OS process lifecycle limitations.
observed_fact: AndroidManifest.xml declares service EventController with foregroundServiceType="location" running in process=":service", along with L360ServiceAppInitProvider and BackgroundProcessContentProvider. Isolation prevents UI crashes from killing the service, but does not guarantee immunity from OS low-memory termination.

claim: EventController implements onStartCommand showing foreground notification and dispatching location events via RxJava pipeline.
observed_fact: EventController.onStartCommand triggers dummy fgsvc notification, initializes controller subsystems, and pushes incoming action intents to RxJava PublishSubject (this.f10371b.onNext(intent)).

claim: LocationReceiver intercepts heartbeat timers, battery optimization dismissals, and geofence transitions, forwarding them to EventController.
observed_fact: LocationReceiver handles ACTION_HEARTBEAT_TIMER, HIDE_BATTERY_SAVER_NOTIF, HIDE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATION_NOTIF, and geofence transitions (INNER, OUTER, LOCAL, BOUNCE_OUT, ZONE), forwarding intent extras to EventController.class.

claim: LocationWorker operates as WorkManager watchdog for local heartbeats and battery/network state recovery.
observed_fact: LocationWorker executes doWork() switching on job-tag 'heartbeat-local', 'network-available', and 'power-connected', verifying location update frequency and waking EventController.

claim: Sensor framework abstracts Google Play Services fused location updates via internal broadcast com.life360.android.sensorframework.action.FUSED_LOCATION_UPDATE.
observed_fact: FusedLocationUpdateBroadcastReceiver extracts LocationResult.getLastLocation() and rebroadcasts it with EXTRA_LOCATION, EXTRA_COMPONENT_ID, and EXTRA_PID.

claim: GeofenceData encapsulates circle place boundaries with latitude, longitude, radius, expiration, and transition configurations.
observed_fact: GeofenceData Parcelable data class contains id, latitude, longitude, radius, expirationDuration, transition flags, and loitering delay.

claim: AccelerometerEventData models high-frequency 3-axis motion sensor readings for collision detection and activity recognition.
observed_fact: AccelerometerEventData extends MultiAxisSensorEventData with Parcelable creator, encapsulating multi-axis acceleration vectors and system nanosecond timestamps.

claim: PSOSAlertRequest encapsulates emergency panic alert dispatch and PIN-secured cancellation protocol.
observed_fact: PSOSAlertRequest models START_ALERT ('REQUEST-ALERT-AUTO') and CANCEL_ALERT ('CANCEL') with user_id, circle_id, location, pin_code, send_to_ag, and send_messages.

claim: TileAdvertisementApi defines Retrofit endpoint for batch ingestion of BLE Tile tracking advertisement broadcasts (standard BLE beacons, not BLE Mesh networking).
observed_fact: TileAdvertisementApi declares @POST("/api/v1/clients/{client_uuid}/batch_location_updates") with tile_app_id, tile_app_version, tile_client_uuid, and tile_request_timestamp headers for uploading batches of observed BLE advertisement payloads.

claim: SQLite/Room schema defines relational persistence for circles, circle_members, places, and driving TripBlock.
observed_fact: local_db_schema.sql contains 10 CREATE TABLE declarations including circles, circle_members, places with radius_meters, and TripBlock telemetry entities.

claim: Catalog of 182 Retrofit method declarations representing 155 unique HTTP endpoints across 19 decompiled interface files.
observed_fact: api_endpoints_catalog.md documents 182 Retrofit method declarations (@GET, @POST, @PUT, @DELETE) mapping to 155 unique (method, path) pairs across 19 decompiled Java interface files in 03_decompiled_src/.

claim: Native librealm-jni.so shared library and io.realm classes are bundled across 5 CPU architectures.
observed_fact: native_so_analysis.md documents librealm-jni.so binaries across 5 ABIs (~4.2 MB arm64-v8a) with bundled io.realm SDK classes; no direct call sites from com.life360 first-party packages are identified, so attribution is strictly limited to the presence of the native JNI library.

claim: Realtime location streaming architecture models PubNub WebSocket channels per circle combined with a REST ingestion gateway (Level B derived architectural model).
observed_fact: realtime_location_streaming_protocol.md models a real-time streaming pipeline subscribing to 'circle_{circleId}_locations' WebSocket channels for map marker updates; latency metrics such as sub-250ms are architectural objectives rather than empirical APK runtime measurements, and the design represents a Level B clean-room model rather than direct APK bytecode evidence.

claim: Clean-room reconstruction of adaptive motion state machine and Kalman GPS smoothing filter.
observed_fact: adaptive_location_and_battery_engine.kt defines MotionActivityType state machine and GpsKalmanFilter class with process noise Q=3.0 m/s for drift reduction (Level B derivative model).

claim: Life360 driving analysis delegates low-level crash physics and high-frequency driving (HFD) processing to Arity SDK.
observed_fact: AndroidManifest.xml declares com.arity.coreEngine.driving.DrivingEngineService, HFDProcessorJobIntentService, and CollisionPayloadJobIntentService, indicating third-party Arity SDK delegation rather than standalone in-house crash physics (Level C inference boundary).
